segments.text: 10/30/76 - featured the announcement from WWWF President Willie Gilzenberg that WWWF Tag Team Champions the Executioners had been stripped of their championship as a result of the 3-on-2 attack in their match last week with Chief Jay Strongbow & Billy Whitewolf, and that a tournament would be held to crown new champions:
